pkgmetadata.longdescription: Distribution kernel built from CachyOS's patched kernel sources, with Gentoo's dist-kernel patchset and configuration, the BORE scheduler and Intel Xe fixes on top. Targets x86-64-v3 and builds with Clang ThinLTO by default.

use.flag: Apply the Burst-Oriented Response Enhancer on top of EEVDF: favours tasks that run in short bursts (desktop, games, audio) over tasks that hold the CPU for long stretches.
Use selection of hardening options recommended by Kernel Self Protection Project. With USE=lto (clang) the GCC-only hardening plugins are unavailable, and kCFI (CONFIG_CFI) is enabled instead.
Build with llvm-core/clang and link with ThinLTO (CONFIG_LTO_CLANG_THIN). Out-of-tree modules are then built with the same clang automatically.

Enable Rust support (CONFIG_RUST): the kernel panic screen then shows a QR code that opens https://drm-panic.obentoo.org with the crash log, and the Rust drivers of the base config are built (Rust binder, Rust PHY drivers). Needs dev-lang/rust or dev-lang/rust-bin with USE=rust-src. The kernel refuses Rust together with BTF under LTO and with the GCC RANDSTRUCT plugin, so it requires -sched-ext -debug with lto, or -hardened without it.
Enable sched_ext (CONFIG_SCHED_CLASS_EXT), so BPF schedulers such as those in sys-kernel/scx can be loaded at runtime. Turns BTF debug info back on.
